questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: Present Simple (am/is) → Past Simple (was/were)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: Present Simple → Past Simple
questions.explanation: When reporting, 'is' changes to 'was' (backshift)

questions.sentence: He told me he ___ help me.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: 'will' → 'would'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: 'will' → 'would'
questions.explanation: 'Will' changes to 'would' in reported speech

questions.sentence: Direct: 'I live in London.' Reported: She said she ___ in London.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: Present Simple → Past Simple
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: Present Simple → Past Simple
questions.explanation: 'Live' (Present) becomes 'lived' (Past) in reported speech

questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: Change pronouns and backshift tenses
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: Olmoshlar va zamonlarni o'zgartiring
questions.explanation: In reported speech, change pronouns and shift tenses back

questions.sentence: She asked me ___ I was from.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Questions (wh-): Use question word + statement order
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma so'roq (wh-): So'roq so'zi + darak gap tartibi
questions.explanation: Wh-questions keep the question word but use statement word order

questions.sentence: He asked me ___ I liked coffee.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Yes/No Questions: Use 'if' or 'whether'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma Ha/Yo'q savollari: 'if' yoki 'whether' ishlating
questions.explanation: Yes/No questions use 'if/whether' in reported speech

questions.sentence: She asked me where did I live.
questions.correct_answer: She asked me where I lived.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Questions: No auxiliary 'do/did', use statement order
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma savollar: 'do/did' ishlatilmaydi, darak tartibi
questions.explanation: In reported questions, use statement word order without 'do/did'

questions.sentence: She told me ___ touch the painting.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Commands (negative): tell + object + not to + verb
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma buyruq (inkor): tell + ob'ekt + not to + fe'l
questions.explanation: Negative commands: 'tell someone not to do something'

questions.original_sentence: "Please help me," she said to him.
questions.correct_answer: She asked/told him to help her.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Requests: ask/tell + object + to + verb
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma iltimos: ask/tell + ob'ekt + to + fe'l
questions.explanation: 'Please' indicates a request: ask/tell someone to do something

questions.sentence: Direct: 'I have finished.' Reported: He said he ___.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: Present Perfect → Past Perfect
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: Present Perfect → Past Perfect
questions.explanation: 'Have finished' becomes 'had finished' (backshift)

questions.sentence: She said she ___ to the party the ___ day.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: Past Simple → Past Perfect
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: Past Simple → Past Perfect
questions.explanation: 'Went' becomes 'had been' when the reporting is later

questions.sentence: He said that he can swim.
questions.correct_answer: He said that he could swim.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Speech: 'can' → 'could'
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma gap: 'can' → 'could'
questions.explanation: Modal 'can' changes to 'could' in reported speech

questions.original_sentence: "Don't be late tomorrow," the teacher said.
questions.correct_answer: The teacher told us not to be late the next day.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Commands: Time expressions also change
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma buyruq: Vaqt iboralari ham o'zgaradi
questions.explanation: 'Don't' → 'not to'; 'tomorrow' → 'the next day'

questions.sentence: She wondered ___ they would arrive on time.
questions.grammar_rule: 'Wonder' + if/whether for indirect yes/no questions
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'Wonder' + if/whether bilvosita ha/yo'q savollari uchun
questions.explanation: 'Wonder' takes 'if/whether' for uncertainty questions

questions.grammar_rule: Special reporting verbs: deny + gerund (-ing)
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Maxsus xabar fe'llari: deny + gerund (-ing)
questions.explanation: 'Deny' is followed by gerund: deny doing something

questions.grammar_rule: Special reporting verbs: apologize for + gerund
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Maxsus xabar fe'llari: apologize for + gerund
questions.explanation: 'Apologize' takes 'for' + gerund: apologize for doing something

questions.original_sentence: "Let's go to the cinema," he said.
questions.correct_answer: He suggested going to the cinema.
questions.grammar_rule: Reported Suggestions: suggest + gerund/that clause
questions.grammar_rule_uz: Ko'chirma taklif: suggest + gerund/that gapi
questions.explanation: 'Let's' becomes 'suggested' + gerund in reported speech

questions.sentence: She suggested me to take a break.
questions.correct_answer: She suggested that I take/should take a break.
questions.grammar_rule: 'Suggest' is not followed by object + infinitive
questions.grammar_rule_uz: 'Suggest' dan keyin ob'ekt + infinitiv kelmaydi
questions.explanation: Use 'suggest that + subject + verb' or 'suggest + gerund'

questions.grammar_rule: remind + object + to + infinitive
questions.grammar_rule_uz: remind + ob'ekt + to + infinitiv
questions.explanation: 'Remind someone to do something' uses infinitive

questions.original_sentence: "Don't touch the wire, it's dangerous," he said.
questions.correct_answer: He warned me/us not to touch the wire because it was dangerous.
questions.grammar_rule: warn + object + (not) to + infinitive
questions.grammar_rule_uz: warn + ob'ekt + (not) to + infinitiv
questions.explanation: 'Warn' for danger/advice: warn someone (not) to do something
